name: SSR, HTML Streaming & DOM Hydration
description: The mechanics of rendering HTML on a server, transmitting it over HTTP, and having browser JavaScript attach event listeners and state to the existing DOM tree.
learning_objectives: Differentiate static HTML parsing from JavaScript DOM hydration.
Explain the root causes of hydration mismatch errors.
Understand why SSR speeds up First Contentful Paint (FCP) but requires JavaScript for Time to Interactive (TTI).
